arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Public debt securities (nominal) in millions from Treasury Bulletin
debt_1960 = 231015  # FY 1960
debt_1961 = 232731  # FY 1961
debt_1962 = 241109  # FY 1962

# CPI-U annual averages (1982-84=100 base)
cpi_1960 = 29.585
cpi_1961 = 29.901667
cpi_1962 = 30.253333

# Adjust to constant 1962 dollars
# Formula: Adjusted = Nominal * (CPI_target / CPI_original)
adjusted_1960 = debt_1960 * (cpi_1962 / cpi_1960)
adjusted_1961 = debt_1961 * (cpi_1962 / cpi_1961)

print(f"FY 1960 nominal debt: ${debt_1960} million")
print(f"FY 1961 nominal debt: ${debt_1961} million")
print(f"FY 1962 nominal debt: ${debt_1962} million")
print()
print(f"FY 1960 adjusted to 1962 dollars: ${adjusted_1960:.6f} million")
print(f"FY 1961 adjusted to 1962 dollars: ${adjusted_1961:.6f} million")
print()

# Calculate absolute difference
difference = abs(adjusted_1961 - adjusted_1960)
print(f"Absolute difference: ${difference:.6f} million")

# Round to thousandths place
difference_rounded = round(difference, 3)
print(f"Rounded to thousandths: ${difference_rounded:.3f} million")
EOF
